concepts.source_guideline: Diagnosis and Treatment of Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer: AUA/SUO Guideline
concepts.clinical_trigger: Low-risk NMIBC patient remains recurrence-free for five years of surveillance
concepts.decision_point: Whether surveillance must continue indefinitely on a fixed schedule
concepts.correct_answer_concept: Continue surveillance after five years only through shared decision-making
concepts.teaching_point: Low-risk NMIBC surveillance can be de-intensified after prolonged recurrence-free follow-up through shared decision-making.

concepts.source_guideline: Medical Management of Kidney Stones: AUA Guideline
concepts.clinical_trigger: Recurrent calcium oxalate stone former has low urinary citrate but cannot tolerate potassium citrate tablets
concepts.decision_point: How to address persistent hypocitraturia when standard formulation is not tolerated
concepts.correct_answer_concept: Use citrate therapy or alternative alkali strategy tailored to tolerability
concepts.teaching_point: Hypocitraturia treatment is a urine-chemistry target, and formulation or alkali strategy may need adjustment for adherence.

concepts.source_guideline: Recurrent Uncomplicated Urinary Tract Infections in Women: AUA/CUA/SUFU Guideline
concepts.clinical_trigger: Woman with recurrent UTI has dysuria but culture is negative and symptoms do not respond to antibiotics
concepts.decision_point: How to manage possible alternative diagnosis
concepts.correct_answer_concept: Evaluate for alternative causes rather than escalating antibiotics
concepts.teaching_point: Recurrent UTI requires symptom-microbiology correlation; culture-negative nonresponse should trigger diagnostic reconsideration.
